purpose: Part 2/2 of verified hard-tail 5-record item effect batch 024; together these files contain exactly 5 self-contained reviewed records.

items/casters-shield-97.name: Caster's Shield
items/casters-shield-97.effectSummary: This +1 light wooden shield has a reusable leather strip that can hold one spell of 3rd level or lower scribed as a scroll. Scribing on the strip costs half the normal base raw materials, while XP and component costs remain unchanged. A randomly found caster's shield has a 50% chance to contain one medium scroll spell, divine on 01–80 or arcane on 81–100, and the shield has a 5% arcane spell failure chance.

items/crown-of-white-ravens.name: Crown of White Ravens
items/crown-of-white-ravens.effectSummary: After being worn continuously for 24 hours, the crown lets the wearer choose and gain use of one White Raven maneuver for which they meet the prerequisite; removing and replacing the crown requires another 24-hour attunement and a new choice. A novice crown grants a maneuver up to 3rd level, a scholar crown up to 6th, and a master crown up to 9th. Equivalent novice, scholar, and master items exist for each other martial discipline and function the same way for that discipline; a Devoted Spirit amulet works only for a wearer sharing its alignment.
